name: adaptive-agent-orchestrator
description: Model-neutral task decomposition, capability routing, KPI verification, and cost-aware orchestration.

interface.longDescription: A model-neutral management skill for complex AI work. It interprets outcomes and constraints, keeps simple tasks direct, decomposes larger requests into bounded functional roles, defines measurable task contracts, routes by required context, tools, modalities, reasoning depth, and quality class, and verifies every returned result against KPIs and evidence before integration. It supports honest fallback from native parallel workers to sequential workers, temporally separated role simulation, or direct execution according to the host's actual capabilities. The portable package does not provide models, connectors, native subagents, or persistent storage by itself. On standard ChatGPT web surfaces it does not claim per-worker model control or persistent scoring.
defaultPrompt: Use Adaptive Agent Orchestrator to plan and complete this task efficiently.
Audit how Adaptive Agent Orchestrator would route and verify this request.
Use direct mode to answer this simply without delegation.
